title: feat(cli): os meta register --mode draft stages a draft, os lint --item judges one item
body:
Fixes #34777

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:逐个编写元数据的开发者或 AI 客户端,现在可以在命令行把一个条目存成某个软件包的待审草稿(不上线),命令会立刻打印这份草稿能否发布的判定和具体问题;不加新参数时与以前完全一样。此外不需要项目也能对单个条目跑本地检查,检查会列出哪些规则需要整个项目才能判断。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 二期与问数」专题,替用命令行和 API 密钥逐条编写的客户端补上「先本地检查、再提交审核、当场看到发布判定」的路径。
- 出错会怎样:草稿只是暂存,不会自动发布;判定不通过只是打印出来,草稿照样保存;没有指定软件包的草稿请求会在发出前被拒绝。出问题可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/client` `meta.getItem`** takes `state: 'draft'` and sends `?state=draft` beside `?package=`, on the unscoped client and on the environment-scoped twin. This is the strict draft read the REST door already serves; its `item._diagnostics` carries what publishing that draft would refuse (#26707). `'active'` is the default said out loud and sends nothing, so a call without the member is the URL it always was. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` shows the read. Changeset: `@objectstack/client` patch.
- **`os meta register TYPE --data FILE --package P --mode draft`** saves through the same door with `?package=P&mode=draft`. It then reads the draft back (`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=P&state=draft`) and prints the publish verdict the runtime serves on it:
  - the text face prints `Publish verdict: valid: true|false, N error(s), M warning(s)`, then each error as `RULE at PATH: MESSAGE`, then each warning;
  - the `--format json|yaml` faces print the door's answer plus `publishVerdict: { valid, errors, warnings }`.
  
  The read is taken as the saved draft's verdict only when it answers the saved draft row's `version`. The door answers a caller it does not admit to drafts with the published item instead, and a draft edited in between is another body. In either case the command prints `Publish verdict not printed: REASON` (`publishVerdict: null` and `publishVerdictUnread` on JSON); it never prints another row's diagnostics as this draft's. A `valid: false` verdict is printed, not turned into a failed run, because the draft is stored either way.
- **`--mode draft` without `--package` is refused before any request** (ruling D4, the MCP draft door's rule). No client is made and nothing reaches the wire. The message names the remedy: `Name the package the draft is staged into with --package PACKAGE_ID (for example --package com.acme.crm).`
- **Unflagged and `--mode publish` runs are unchanged.** They send the same single `PUT` with no query string, and no read follows it.
- **`os lint --item FILE --type TYPE`** (unchanged from the first round) judges one JSON item without a project (`packages/cli/src/lint/item-lint.ts`, `judgeItemAlone`). Each entry of the shared rule table (`authoringRulesFor('lint')`) runs through a proxy that records the top-level stack keys the entry reads:
  - only the item's own collection: the entry judged the item, and its findings are reported;
  - the item's collection plus any other key: the entry is listed under `notJudged` with those keys, and its findings are dropped;
  - never the item's collection: the entry does not judge that type and is skipped.

  `os lint`'s per-entry naming, label and structure checks (`entryConventionIssues`, lifted unchanged out of `lintConfig`) run on the item. The namespace-prefix, i18n-coverage and (for objects) data-model families are listed under `familiesNotRun`. Measured at 1545a86f96: object 10 judged / 28 not, view 1/17, flow 4/9, dashboard 1/9, app 0/11. Classifying per member or per pass, which would judge more entries, is the follow-up card #35695.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the `os lint` options rows, the **One item** paragraph, and the draft-and-verdict sentence. Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/client/src/meta-get-item-draft-read.test.ts` (new) pins the URL on both declarations: `?package=P&state=draft`, `?state=draft` alone, and the control, where an omitted state or `'active'` gives the URL it always sent.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register-draft.test.ts` (integration tier) runs the real `RestServer`, protocol and `sys_metadata` on SQLite, with the real SDK. Cases:
  - **draft:** the wire is exactly `PUT ...?package=P&mode=draft`, then `GET ...?package=P&state=draft`, and the text face prints `valid: true`;
  - **JSON face:** carries `publishVerdict`;
  - **refused publish:** an object carrying the retired `titleFormat` prints `Publish verdict: valid: false` with `title-format-retired` on both faces, and is still stored as a draft;
  - **D4:** `--mode draft` without `--package` exits 1 on both faces, with `createApiClient` not called, an empty wire and no save request;
  - **controls:** unflagged and `--mode publish` send no request but the `PUT`;
  - **unit:** `draftPublishVerdictOf` (another row's `version` is no verdict) and the refusal message.
- `packages/cli/src/lint/item-lint.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/lint-item.test.ts`: as in the first round.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured live** on a self-hosted runtime (`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38777`, showcase), signed in with an API key minted at `POST /api/v1/keys` and passed as `OS_TOKEN`, with package `com.qa.items` installed. At f0520d6a23:
  - `os meta register object --data ticket.json --package com.qa.items --mode draft` exited 0 and printed `Publish verdict: valid: true, 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).`
  - The same command on the `titleFormat` item exited 0 and printed `Publish verdict: valid: false, 1 error(s), 0 warning(s)`, then `title-format-retired items_bad: titleFormat is retired (ADR-0079) ...`.
  - `--format json` on that item carried `publishVerdict.valid: false` with code `title-format-retired`.
  - Without `--package`, the command exited 1 with the refusal.
  - `GET /meta/_drafts?package=com.qa.items` listed both drafts. This is the read Studio's Changes drawer lists a package's drafts from; Studio itself was not driven.
  - `os lint --item` on the `titleFormat` item exits 1 on the same rule.
- The verdict read is one extra `GET`, sent only on a `--mode draft` run.
- Exit code 0 on a `valid: false` verdict is deliberate. The command stages; `os lint --item` is the pre-flight that fails a run.

## Verification

- **Red first** (sources restored to the merge commit 7c12291fde, new tests kept):
  - client pin: 4 of 6 failed (the two controls held);
  - `register-draft`: 6 of 10 failed (flag declaration, mapping, review lines and the negative control held).
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD`; both blobs equal HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **Ablation:** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the saved-version guard in `draftPublishVerdictOf` with `false` (anchor 1 to 0, blob b470fca86094 to 9a02b77f0f7f). `register-draft` then failed 1 of 10, the version-mismatch case. Restored to blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. No build was needed: the subject is the CLI's own source.
- **Green at f0520d6a23:**
  - client pins plus `package-addressing`: 89 of 89;
  - the whole client suite (`--maxWorkers=2`): 59 files, 818 tests;
  - `register-draft`, `register-package` and `register-force` (integration): 25 of 25;
  - `register-requires-name`, `remote-api-commands` and the tier partition pin (unit): 48 of 48.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck` gave VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 104 families): all exit 0. `--ran`: 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:skill-examples` and `check:dts-closure` first answered as prerequisites, because the workspace build was running beside them. They are green after the client was rebuilt directly.
- **CI on f0520d6a23:** 60 success, 10 skipped, 0 failing.

## Read first

1. `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts`, `draftPublishVerdictOf` and `reportDraft`. The risk is the version guard: it is what keeps the published item's diagnostics from being printed as the draft's.
2. `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts`, `metaRegisterOptions`. The D4 refusal runs before the client exists. The risk is any path that saves before it.
3. `packages/client/src/index.ts`, both `getItem` declarations. Only `'draft'` puts a parameter on the wire.

Two-minute check: `os meta register object --data ITEM.json --package PACKAGE_ID --mode draft` against a runtime, with a `titleFormat` in the item, prints `Publish verdict: valid: false` and a `title-format-retired` line.
